tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the rail, panels and tabs. Cool green-grey, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, the project rail, top bar, tab bar, KPI strip, floating info card, buttons.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, hover on rail items, sub-total rows, alternating Gantt week columns.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text on bg, surface, sunk and accent-soft (14:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, table headers, KPI labels, chart axis text, inactive tabs. Reads 5.1:1+ on bg, surface, sunk and accent-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px borders: panels, buttons, inputs, table outer rules, KPI strip frame. Decorative separation only: 1.4:1 on surface, so it does not meet the 3:1 control-border guideline; the focus ring (accent) carries state instead.

tokens.name: line2
tokens.usage: Inner hairlines: table row rules, dividers between KPI cells, chart gridlines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Engineering blue. Primary button fill, active tab underline, selected rail item border, focus ring, the main S-Curve line. 6.3:1+ on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (primary button). Flips to near-black in dark because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rail item fill, BOQ category header rows, weekly value bars behind the S-Curve.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive button text, critical-path Gantt bars, failed clash checks. Pair with a word (วิกฤต / ไม่ผ่าน), never color alone.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Passed checks, the 'saved' status dot. Differs from crit in lightness as well as hue; still always paired with a label.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and the 'unsaved changes' status dot.

tokens.name: c-S
tokens.usage: Discipline S, โครงสร้าง (structure): BOQ category swatch, cost bar segment, S-Curve dashed line.

tokens.name: c-A
tokens.usage: Discipline A, สถาปัตย์ (architecture): BOQ swatch, cost bar segment, S-Curve dashed line.

tokens.name: c-P
tokens.usage: Discipline P, สุขาภิบาล (plumbing / sanitary): BOQ swatch, cost bar segment, S-Curve dashed line.

tokens.name: c-E
tokens.usage: Discipline E, ไฟฟ้า (electrical): BOQ swatch, cost bar segment, S-Curve dashed line. Fills only; 3.3:1 on surface in light, too low for text.

tokens.name: gantt
tokens.usage: Non-critical Gantt activity bars; fifth color in the category palette for non-house projects.

tokens.name: scene
tokens.usage: Background of the 3D viewer (three.js scene.background reads this token).

tokens.name: scene-edge
tokens.usage: Edge lines drawn over 3D meshes (LineBasicMaterial 0x2a2f2d at 0.28 opacity). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: scene-select
tokens.usage: Box3Helper outline around the selected 3D element. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: mat-concrete

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs and between a brand name and its sub-line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between rail items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button row gap; gap from a status dot to its text.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; KPI cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between panel heading and content; rail item horizontal padding; info card inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tab horizontal padding; KPI cell horizontal padding; gap inside the top bar.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Rail section gap; panel vertical padding; top bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel gaps in the work area; panel horizontal padding; rail padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Work area vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Work area, top bar and tab bar horizontal padding (the app gutter).

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Padding of an empty state.

tokens.name: r
tokens.usage: The one structural radius: panels, buttons, inputs, KPI strip, rail items, 3D viewer, info card.

tokens.name: r-input
tokens.usage: Small inline number inputs inside table cells.

tokens.name: r-bar
tokens.usage: Cost bar; category swatches use 2px.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Project rail column on desktop; the rail stacks above the work area below 860px.

tokens.name: breakpoint-stack
tokens.usage: Width below which the two-column app becomes one column.

tokens.name: panel-min
tokens.usage: Minimum column width of the two-up panel grid (auto-fit).

tokens.name: kpi-min
tokens.usage: Minimum KPI cell width (auto-fit).

tokens.name: field-min
tokens.usage: Minimum form field column width (auto-fit).

tokens.name: viewer-max
tokens.usage: 3D viewer height cap; height is min(68vh, 640px).
